Compile seus scripts com o **compilador: Compile your scripts with the **open.mp compiler** — version **3.10.11** is the recommended one, and **3.10.10** has also been tested (on Windows, debugging has not been verified yet). It is the recommended compiler both for engine analysis and for debugging; others may produce incompatible code or debug information.
O adaptador vem na extensão e inicia soz: The adapter ships with the extension and starts on its own. The only manual step is installing the **server plugin** — once per server. The same binary works for **SA-MP** and **open.mp**.
**1. Baixe o plugin** na [release do Paw: **1. Download the plugin** from the [PawnPro Debugger release]({0}): `pawnpro_debug.so` (Linux) or `pawnpro_debug.dll` (Windows). Do not rename it.
**2a. open.mp** — copie o binário para a: **2a. open.mp** — copy the binary into the `components/` folder. The server discovers it on its own; no registration is needed.
**2b. SA-MP** — copie para `plugins/` e: **2b. SA-MP** — copy it into `plugins/` and add `pawnpro_debug.so` to the `plugins` line in `server.cfg`.
Abra o gamemode (`.pwn`), clique na marg: Open the gamemode (`.pwn`), click the gutter to set breakpoints and press **F5**. The extension recompiles with `-d3`, checks the plugin, starts the server and connects. Output appears in the **Debug Console**.
